question.prompt: To learn about the physical fitness of all 1200 students in a school, which sampling plan is the most reasonable? ( )

solutions.explanation: The sample should be representative, covering all grade levels with random selection. B, C, and D would all bias the sample toward a particular group of students.
solutions.title: Representativeness and random selection
